verdict.rationale: Docs explicitly describe writes pausing for human sign-off, cost-incurring actions surfacing estimates, and asks-only-when-needed human decisions plus delegated approvals, directly matching the pause-for-approval story. However, this is only first-party marketing copy with no independent/hands-on corroboration, no detail on how approval UI/notifications work, and API/llms.txt probes returned 404s suggesting limited technical documentation depth. Missing for 10: independent verification of the approval workflow in practice, technical/API documentation of the pause mechanism, and detail on notification/resume UX for approvers.
